test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six girls, P, Q, R, S, T and V, are sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle. P sits to the immediate right of Q. S is 3rd to the right of P, and to the immediate left of R. V and T are immediate neighbours. T is second to the left of R. Who is to the immediate left of V?
solution:
Given: Six girls, P, Q, R, S, T and V, are sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle. 

1) P sits to the immediate right of Q. S is 3rd to the right of P, and to the immediate left of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdfb5a2200655152640d3c1f614041da664d112c92f5e0a3ca68762feeeed768.png] 

2) V and T are immediate neighbours. 

3) T is second to the left of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309fc7ba6632c6c8f5dd949ae3fd7cea92a45130cc047927766555e8f064d038.png] 

So, '**P' sits to the immediate left of V**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
